name: ile-oyo-theme-repo
description: Build, tests and sources for the Ilé-Ọ̀yọ́ themes (private; not published).

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build -- --check && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:sass && npm run test:types
scripts.package:vscode: npm test && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && cd themes/vscode && vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../dist/
scripts.pack:css: npm test && cd themes/css && npm pack --dry-run
